title: PumpAI
tagline: AI Powered Meme Coin Launchpad - AI Generates the images and some metadata
description:
Pump AI is an AI powered Memecoin Launchpad allowing you to easily create, launch, promote and trade meme coins using a fair launch mechanism via our bonding curve, No need for Initial Liquidity.

Pump AI reduces rug pulls by 

- Requiring Coin Creators to Publicly attest they have fulfilled KYC usig Sign Protocol
- Using our Bonding curve to implement a Fair Launch Mechanism, i.e even creators need to purchase coins 

Pump AI deployed on Galadriel L1 allows you to use the Galdriel AI service to generate your Memecoin's details based on any topic you chose including

- Name & Symbol
- Good Description
- Meme Coin Image based on your topic selected and AI generated keywords for the prompt
- Landing Page HTML code for you to use

Pump AI supports multiple DEXes and allows you to choose which DEX to deploy to based on what chain you are deploying on
how_its_made:
We use Sign Protocol( their NPM SDK ) for KYC attestation, Galadriel AI for onChain AI and the testnet deployment is deployed to the Morph Holesky Chain and Galadriel L1

We use hardhat for all our smart contracts, Asp.Net API for our indexer and backend API and Angular 17 and WAGMI Core/Wallet Modal for the frontend,
